## RE:volution Mod v1.2.0

This release establishes the current stable project baseline after the v1.1.x series and prepares further development around a single persistent server workflow.

### Added

- Added v1.2.0 release documentation and version metadata.
- Documented the current persistent-server development workflow.
- Preserved the existing regression coverage for rune inventory, layout, scaling, search, click targets and awakening guards.

### Fixed

- No separate gameplay bug fixes are introduced in this release.
- Removed outdated active documentation describing the previous world and database snapshot workflow.

### Other

- The existing GUI, rune purchasing and middle-click awakening behavior is intentionally preserved.
- The current local development workflow keeps its world and MongoDB data between runs instead of replacing them from another environment.
- Passed the local clean build, layout/input regression checks and rune inventory regression checks.
- The user completed a manual Minecraft client smoke test for v1.2.0 and confirmed that startup, server connection and the main GUI scenarios work correctly. No separate extended GUI stress pass is claimed.
- Minecraft 1.12.2 and Forge 14.23.5.2859 remain the supported runtime.

### Download

Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.0.jar`.
The client and server must use the same mod version.

Required resource pack:
[RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0)

Choose either:

- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-64x64.zip`
- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-128x128.zip`

**Full Changelog:** [v1.1.7...v1.2.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.1.7...v1.2.0)
